name: learning-session
description: Coordinates source-library, learner-state, learning-curriculum, and learning-visuals to manage adaptive learning-session state while leaving teaching judgment to the LLM.

/learn.description: Start an adaptive learning session for a topic.

/lesson-status.description: Show the active lesson topic, concept, stage, path, evidence, and active misconceptions.

/end-lesson.description: End the active lesson, save structured metadata, and archive the session state.

start_learning_session.description: Start a session: inspect curriculum, learner state, prerequisites, learning path, sources, and return a teaching brief.

get_next_teaching_action.description: Recommend the next teaching action from current session state and recent evidence without generating lesson content.

record_learning_event.description: Record structured session events such as concept introduction, visual shown, checkpoint completed, or misconception found.

advance_learning_concept.description: Decide whether to continue, review a prerequisite, move to the next concept, test transfer, or complete the session.
